scientific_integrity: Explicit proof and standard-library reproducibility checks are supplied. Exact rational and finite numerical tests do not imply the universal statement; the proof does. Publication priority cannot be established exhaustively.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected undirected positively weighted simple graphs, positive masses and one common real p>1. The globally sharp constant concerns instantaneous one-solution vertex oscillation; no fixed-time optimality, two-input metric contraction, directed or infinite graphs is asserted. The p=2 diameter-two criterion is existing literature.
title: Sharp oscillation dissipation for weighted nonlinear graph heat
